measurement.question: Under the proposed conditions, how likely are you to attempt a mattress purchase?

model_version: GPT-6 authored text, not an independent API run

configuration.prompt_contract: free text response to predeclared five-point question

responses.text: I would probably buy if someone reliably picked up the mattress and refunded me if it did not work, but I would still check with my wife.
responses.mechanism: Reduced anticipated loss or disposal burden
responses.next_test: Offer an actual pickup-backed trial and observe paid attempts

responses.text: I might consider it, but I am still unsure whether I trust an unknown seller to honor the collection promise.
responses.mechanism: Trust in the promise may matter as much as logistics
responses.next_test: Hold pickup fixed and compare verified seller familiarity

limitations: Teaching artifact, not approved through formal human review-gated record command
GPT-6 authored two variants, not independent samples of a human population
Source interview is one person; no independent validation outcomes exist
